sentences.text: (By Shri Anil Shukla - Public Prosecutor.
Shri Girraj Soni - Advocate For Complainant)

This application coming on for hearing this day, the court passed the following:
 ORDER
This is third bail application u/S.439 Cr.P.C filed by the applicant for grant of bail.
First bail application was dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 28.06.2022 passed in M.Cr.C.27092/2022.
Second bail application was dismissed on 15.09.2022 vide order dated 43977/2022 by co-ordinate Bench who is on long leave.
Due to this, the application is placed before this Bench.
He was released on bail on the condition that if FSL report found to be positive, the order will automatically cancelled.
FSL report has come positive but he could not be released because when he presented bail bonds, the FSL report has already came on record which is positive.

sentences.text:
Applicant has been arrested on 12.04.2022 by Police Station- Kotwali Vdisha, Distt. Vidisha, in connection with Crime No.167/2022 for the offence punishable under Sections 354, 354-A, 376,
376(A,B), (I), 376(2)(F) of IPC, 3,4, 5(K)/6, 5(M)/6, 5(N)/6, 9(K), 9(M), 9(N), 10 POCSO Act.

entities.text: Police Station- Kotwali Vdisha, Distt. Vidisha
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: In brief facts of the case are that 27.03.2022 at 10 P.M., mother of the prosecutrix lodged a computerized complaint with Police Station Kotwali Vidsha against her nephew present applicant/accused Rithik that her daughter prosecutrix is physically and mentally retarded.
On 26.03.2022 at 4.30 P.M., present applicant/accused came to her house, at that time, she along with her son Kishan and prosecutrix were resent.
She prepared tea.
His son went for coaching that is why she went to see him off.
Present applicant/accused remained in the house.
When she reached near temple she thought that she will tell the applicant/accused to leave son in coaching centre.
When she came back and knocked the door.
The door could not be opened.
She peep through window.
Present applicant/accused was closing the chain of the pant.
He put on underwear of her daughter.
Thereafter, opened the door.
She telephoned er husband.
Applicant/accused fled away from the house.

On her report, offence under Sections 354, 354-A, 376, 376(A,B), (I), 376(2)(F) of IPC, 3,4,
5(K)/6, 5(M)/6, 5(N)/6, 9(K), 9(M), 9(N), 10 POCSO Act bearing crime No.167/2022 was registered.
Proscutrix was sent for medical examination.
Abrasion lateral wall of vagina redness tenderness were found.
Statement was recorded.
Learned counsel for the applicant submits that during trial mother who lodged the report has not supported the prosecution case.
He is under custody since 12.04.2022.

After investigation,
charge-sheet has been submitted.
Conclusion of the trial will take time.
Therefore, prays for grant of bail.
Learned counsel for the State opposed the application and prayed for its rejection.
Heard learned counsel for both the parties and perused the case diary.

Looking to the facts and circumstances case applicant is in custody since 12.04.2022 and conclusion of the tril will take time,
this Court is of the opinion that the application should be allowed and by allowing the application it is ordered that if the applicant furnishes cash security of Rs.25,000/- (Twenty Five Thousand only)
alongwith bail bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- (Rs. Twenty Five thousand only) before the trial Court, he should be released on bail.
He will present during trial before the trial Court on each and every date.
In case of any default, cash security of Rs.25,000/- shall be forfeited without giving him any notice.
Application stands allowed and disposed of.
Certified copy as per rules.

(DEEPAK KUMAR AGARWAL) JUDGE mani SUBASRI MANI 2023.01.19 18:24:55 -08'00'
